title: Patriots Stock Watch 1.0: Who is rising, falling on depth chart after 11 days of practice?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez excel in Patriots training camp, impressing coaches with their competitive performances.
Dre'Mont Jones and Gabe Jacas stand out in defensive drills, enhancing their positions on the depth chart.
Caleb Lomu and Lan Larison face challenges, with Lomu hit by a rookie wall and Larison losing reps after a fumble.

title: Could Franklin Arias join Red Sox before end of 2026 season?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Franklin Arias is batting .326 with 12 RBI and strong defense in his first 10 Triple-A games.
The 20-year-old is the No. 2 baseball prospect, impressing with Worcester since his call-up.
Red Sox evaluating Arias for potential call-up as injuries affect shortstop Trevor Story's return.

title: Police search for person they say broke into Jamaica Plain apartment, tried to pull blanket off sleeping victim
author: Audrey Cooney
bullets: Boston police seek public help to identify a suspect who broke into a Jamaica Plain apartment.
The incident occurred on Aug. 5 when a suspect entered through a bedroom window on Heath Street.
The suspect, described as a Black male in his late teens or early 20s, fled after attempting to remove a blanket.

title: Why did this part break so quickly on my 2023 pickup?
author: John Paul
bullets: A 2023 Ford Maverick owner reports broken sway bar links after 22,000 miles, suspecting low-quality parts.
John Paul recommends warranty repairs or aftermarket parts for 2023 Ford Maverick's broken sway bar links.
Torx-Plus fasteners on cars are stronger than Torx, offering a more precise fit for automated assembly.

title: 5 takeaways from Jaylen Brown’s introductory press conference with 76ers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jaylen Brown described mixed emotions over his trade from the Boston Celtics to the Philadelphia 76ers.
He expressed dissatisfaction with the Celtics' handling of his departure after a decade with the team.
Brown acknowledged a lack of personal relationship with former teammate Jayson Tatum post-trade.

title: 4 injured in Boston school bus rollover, police say
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Four adults injured in a school bus rollover in Mattapan, Boston on Thursday afternoon.
The accident occurred near 1000 Harvard St.; victims sustained non-life-threatening injuries.
The cause of the bus rollover is unclear; no children were on board during the crash.

title: Drake Maye struggled during two-minute drill, and other takeaways from Day 11 of Patriots training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye threw two interceptions during the two-minute drill, with one picked by Marcus Jones and another by Kevin Byard.
With left tackle Will Campbell limited, Marcus Bryant took first-team reps at left tackle instead of first-round pick Caleb Lomu.
Rookie linebacker Gabe Jacas participated in first-team reps, indicating progress in his return to play plan.

title: A beloved Cape Cod restaurant is closing after 21 years
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Chach Restaurant in Provincetown will close on November 2 after 21 years of operation, say owners Viola Briseño and Sharon Bowes.
Known for its scratch-made breakfast and lunch menu, Chach has been a fixture on Shank Painter Road with a 52-seat capacity.
Owners cite the demands of running a restaurant and staffing challenges in Provincetown as reasons for closing.

title: The best movies on Netflix right now (August 2026)
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Clueless' (1995) featuring Alicia Silverstone and Stacey Dash is streaming on Netflix, based loosely on Jane Austen's 'Emma'.
Bo Burnham's 'Eighth Grade' (2018) highlights a 13-year-old's anxiety in middle school, drawing from the director's own experiences.
'Inside Man' (2006), a bank heist film featuring Denzel Washington and Clive Owen, remains a popular choice on Netflix.

title: Navy says it can’t help recover wreckage of Gloucester fishing boat Lily Jean
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: US Navy declines to assist in recovering Gloucester fishing boat Lily Jean wreckage, citing inability to fulfill the request.
The Lily Jean sank with seven aboard near Cape Ann in January 2026; families seek investigation closure.
Massachusetts Governor Maura Healey and state officials continue to seek federal assistance for the investigation.
